_note: Official university logos, shown only on each university's own page (decision 049). Keyed by university id. file: path under app/static/ (SVG or PNG, self-hosted); source_url: the page where the logo was found (the university's own site or its Wikimedia Commons file page); asset_url: the file downloaded; licence: as stated on the source (Commons licence, or 'official website, trademark'); retrieved: date downloaded. A university with no entry shows no logo.
